messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 49(4)

Article 49 Confidentiality. 4. The Commission and Member States may exchange confidential information with regulatory authorities of third countries with which they have bilateral or multilateral confidentiality agreements and arrangements when those agreements and arrangements ensure that any exchange of information is in accordance with applicable Union law.

response.text:
The Commission | mayExchange | confidential information with regulatory authorities of third countries | the Commission and Member States have bilateral or multilateral confidentiality agreements and arrangements with those authorities | The Commission and Member States may exchange confidential information with regulatory authorities of third countries
Member States | mayExchange | confidential information with regulatory authorities of third countries | the Member States have bilateral or multilateral confidentiality agreements and arrangements with those authorities | The Commission and Member States may exchange confidential information with regulatory authorities of third countries
Exchange with third-country regulatory authorities | requires | bilateral or multilateral confidentiality agreements and arrangements | the Commission or Member States have such agreements with those authorities | with which they have bilateral or multilateral confidentiality agreements and arrangements
Confidentiality agreements and arrangements | ensureCompliance | any exchange of information is in accordance with applicable Union law | the agreements and arrangements ensure this | when those agreements and arrangements ensure that any exchange of information is in accordance with applicable Union law
